question: Sincere congratulations on the second season of the anime! Also, thank you very much! I'm looking forward to Bonds of Ice, too! And Happy Birthday, Otto! Question: What does Otto think of as the best thing that happened due to having the Blessing of the Spirit of Words?
answer: The blessing has brought misfortune to Otto, but also good fortune. Basically, Otto is grateful for the "Blessing of the Spirit of Words" at times when he is able to help someone in the Emilia camp thanks to it.
